crossRefs.note: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness…
While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he…
Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the…
Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God, and was going to God,
Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am…
But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”
I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name…
But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.
So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven, and sat down at the right hand of God.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.
translations.bsb: So Jesus said, “I am with you only a little while longer, and then I am going to the One who sent Me.
translations.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.
translations.asv: Jesus therefore said, Yet a little while am I with you, and I go unto him that sent me.
